about.title: About Encrypt-D
about.description: Encrypt-D is a secure application for encrypting and protecting your sensitive folders with military-grade encryption (AES-256-GCM).
how_it_works: 1. Set up a master password to protect the application
2. Add folders you want to encrypt - they'll be secured in a hidden vault
3. Your folders are encrypted with AES-256-GCM using your password
4. Decrypt anytime with your password to restore full folder structure
5. Auto-destruction protects your data if someone tries to break in
about.security_info: Your data is encrypted with industry-standard AES-256-GCM. The master password is hashed using PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 100,000 iterations. After {max_attempts} failed login attempts, all encrypted data is permanently destroyed.
